The University of Michigan's Index of Consumer Sentiment came in at 51.0 for August, down from 55.2 in July, a month-over-month decline of 7.6%. Economists surveyed by Reuters had forecast a reading of 54.5. A Bloomberg survey of economists had projected 55. [...] The decline was broad-based. While views of personal finances saw only minor changes, expected business conditions sank 11% for the short run and 17% for the long run, according to the survey.
